meta.title: 来学几个方圆脸上镜技巧！轻松爆改鹅蛋脸
meta.title_en: Makeup Angles for Round-Square Faces: Effortlessly Egg-Shaped

scenes.title_cn: 回头技巧：回头不是这样——是头回肩膀…
scenes.title_en: Turning back: not like this—the head turns…
scenes.context: 头回肩不回+头侧倾遮下颌角。
sentences: 回头不是这样，是头回肩膀不回。
Turning back is not like this—the head turns while the shoulders stay.
head turns, shoulders stay（头回肩不回）
回头同时头顶往一边倒，脸型更流畅。
Tilt the crown to one side as you turn for a smoother face shape.
tilt the crown（头顶侧倾）
再用头发挡住下颌角，眼神看镜头下方。
Then cover the jawline with hair; eyes look below the lens.
cover the jawline（挡下颌角）
scenes.speak: Turning back is not like this—the head turns while the shoulders stay. Tilt the crown to one side as you turn for a smoother face shape. Then cover the jawline with hair; eyes look below the lens.

scenes.title_cn: 正面披发：还正面不是这样——头发全部…
scenes.title_en: Front with hair down: not like this—hair o…
scenes.context: 单侧披发+四分之三侧身。
sentences: 头发全部放在两边，会框住脸型，显得脸更大。
Hair on both sides frames the face and makes it look bigger.
frames the face（框住脸型）
全部撩在一侧，留一侧头发下来修饰脸型。
Sweep it all to one side, leaving strands to slim the face.
one-side hair（单侧披发）
身体转向四分之三侧，头顶往镜头。
Turn the body to three-quarter view, crown toward the lens.
three-quarter view（四分之三侧）
scenes.speak: Hair on both sides frames the face and makes it look bigger. Sweep it all to one side, leaving strands to slim the face. Turn the body to three-quarter view, crown toward the lens.

scenes.title_cn: 低头技巧：低头看似不是这样——眉眼会…
scenes.title_en: Looking down: not like this—the brows look…
scenes.context: 低头时头侧倾+眼神放松。
sentences: 低头看似不是这样，眉眼会显凶。
Looking down isn't like this—the brows look fierce.
brows look fierce（眉眼显凶）
头顶往一边倒，低头眼神放松看地面。
Tilt the crown, then look down with relaxed eyes toward the ground.
relaxed eyes（眼神放松）
scenes.speak: Looking down isn't like this—the brows look fierce. Tilt the crown, then look down with relaxed eyes toward the ground.

scenes.title_cn: 坐姿：拍坐姿不要这样——手臂有肉会全…
scenes.title_en: Sitting pose: not like this—arm flesh gets…
sentences: 拍坐姿不要这样，手臂有肉会全部挤出来。
For a sitting pose, don't do this—arm flesh gets squeezed out.
flesh squeezed out（肉被挤出）
利用披肩挡住手臂，双手抱手挡住小肚子。
Use the shawl to cover the arms; cross hands to hide the belly.
cover the arms（挡手臂）
scenes.speak: For a sitting pose, don't do this—arm flesh gets squeezed out. Use the shawl to cover the arms; cross hands to hide the belly.

practice: The head turns while the shoulders stay.
Sweep hair to one side, leaving strands down.
Tilt the crown and relax your eyes downward.
Use a shawl to cover the arms, cross hands for the belly.
pitfalls: Turn only the head; keep the shoulders still.
Sweep it to one side to slim the face.
Tilt the crown and relax your gaze toward the ground.
低头要放松眼神看地面。
Leave arms bare in sitting shots.
Cover arms with the shawl and cross hands for the belly.
坐姿用披肩挡手臂、抱手挡肚。
shifts: 用 three-quarter view（四分之三侧）、turn head only（头回肩不回）
用 one-side hair（单侧披发）、frame the face（框住脸型）、slim the face（修饰脸型）
用 cover the jawline（挡下颌角）、cover the arms（挡手臂）、hide the belly（挡小肚）
footer_notes: 转录基于图文实录完整口播。已校正：回头肩膀不回、头顶往一边倒、脸型流畅、头发挡下颌角、眼神看镜头下方、头发放两边显脸大、撩在一侧、留一侧修饰脸型、四分之三侧、眉眼显凶、眼神放松看地面、坐姿手臂有肉、披肩挡手臂、抱手挡小肚子等。
